newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 2.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following stories on its front page April 2:

WASHINGTON - Figures released Tuesday show the U.S. economy is continuing to expand a such a strong pace that the Federal Reserve is likely to raise interest rates again next month unless there are clear signs that the growth is slowing, financial analysts say.
WASHINGTON - Online computer service giant America Online is exploring a bid to buy its rival CompuServe, industry sources say.

WASHINGTON - Top White House aides Erskine Bowles and Mack McLarty contacted friends to help find work for President Clinton's friend Webster Hubbell after he resigned from the Justice Department in 1994, the White House said.
WASHINGTON - Immigrants voiced a growing sense of alarm about the impact of a new immigration law that took effect Tuesday as advocacy groups began court action to overturn it.
